progression.narrative: The performance opens on A2 and dwells most on A in Kereshmeh-e Rak. Safir-e Rak (0:13.4) introduces E, Fs, Gb, centred on A. The line peaks at Ab4 (416.9 Hz) at 0:34.7. It closes on the tonic (Gb4 → A2 → E4 → A2 → A2 → A3).
